title: True Vanilla
description: True Vanilla is a pure vanilla semi-anarchy Minecraft server with no /tpa, no /homes, and no pay-to-win. Pure survival, like it was meant to be.
body:
# 🎮 True Vanilla

Welcome to **True Vanilla**, the ultimate *pure vanilla Minecraft* experience!

## 🌍 What Makes True Vanilla Special

- **100% Vanilla Gameplay**: No teleportation commands (`/home`, `/warp`, `/tpa`), no land claims, no pay-to-win perks. Just *true Minecraft* survival.
- **Semi-Anarchy Environment**: Freedom to explore, build, raid, and PvP
- **Multiple Worlds**:
  - **Core**: A long-term world with **no resets**.
  - **Windfall**: A world with periodic resets based on monthly community polls.
- **Community-Powered**: Work alone, join forces, or clash with others.

There's nothing between you and Minecraft's original survival experience. No fancy plugins, just the game *exactly* the way Mojang intended.

## 📜 Server Info

- **IP:** `mc.truevanilla.net`
- **Versions:** Minecraft Java **1.20.x - 1.21.x**
- **"Premium" Java Only** (non-cracked)
- **Rules & Community Guidelines:** Be respectful, no cheating and follow [the rules](https://truevanilla.net/wiki/Rules)

## 🧭 Getting Started Quickly

1. Launch **Minecraft: Java Edition** (1.20.x - 1.21.x).
2. Go to **Multiplayer** -> **Add Server**.  
3. Name it **True Vanilla** and enter: `mc.truevanilla.net`  
4. Join it and start playing!

## 🤝 Join the Community

[Join the **Discord**](https://discord.truevanilla.net) to meet players, share builds, get updates, and hear about the latest news. You can also read our [wiki](https://truevanilla.net/wiki/Main_Page) or [Beginner's Guide](https://truevanilla.net/wiki/A_Beginner%27s_Guide_to_the_Server).
